preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and 0 <= x <= 100000 for x in [h12, h13, h14, h23, h24, h34])
preconditions.description: All Hamming distances are non-negative integers not exceeding 100000.

preconditions.expression: any(x > 0 for x in [h12, h13, h14, h23, h24, h34])
preconditions.description: At least one Hamming distance is positive.
The Hamming distances are not all equal.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(s1) == len(s2) == len(s3) == len(s4) and all(c in 'ab' for s in [s1, s2, s3, s4] for c in s))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, all strings must be of equal length and consist only of 'a' and 'b'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (h(s1, s2) == h12 and h(s1, s3) == h13 and h(s1, s4) == h14 and h(s2, s3) == h23 and h(s2, s4) == h24 and h(s3, s4) == h34)
postconditions.description: The Hamming distances between the restored strings must match the given distances.
The length of the strings must be the minimum possible length.
